SAMAN Portable manufactures container offices and delivers them ready to use across Sri City. We build each unit to order at our own ISO-certified factory, then dispatch it fitted â€” walls, flooring, wiring, windows and doors done â€” to the SEZ, the Domestic Tariff Zone and the factory plots inside the Sri City township. You deal with the maker, not a reseller or a marketplace listing. For models, sizes and finishes, see our full Modular Container Office Cabin for Sri City SEZ Units range, then send your requirement for a quote.

A container office is a steel-framed office cabin built inside a container-style shell. Because it arrives finished, your team can move in the day it lands â€” no site masonry, no wet work and no long build wait. Inside a large integrated zone like Sri City, that lets a contractor or a new unit set up a project office, a gate cabin or an admin room fast, and relocate it later as the plot develops.

Who buys a container office in Sri City

Sri City is a multi-sector integrated zone with electronics, appliances, FMCG, auto and building-material units, and most of our enquiries here come from:

  • SEZ and DTZ contractors needing a temporary project and coordination office
  • Electronics, appliance and light-manufacturing units needing an admin or supervisor cabin
  • Warehousing and logistics units needing a combined storage-and-office point
  • Units needing a gate and security office at the plot entrance

Every unit we supply is a project, administrative or gate cabin â€” a clean, insulated workspace. We do not market these as bonded, process or hazardous-area structures.

Where we deliver in and around Sri City

We supply container offices across the zones of the Sri City township:

  • Sri City SEZ (Special Economic Zone) â€” 517646
  • Domestic Tariff Zone (DTZ) â€” 517646
  • Free Trade and Warehousing Zone (FTWZ) â€” 517646
  • Sri City on the Satyavedu and Varadaiahpalem side â€” 517646

Because these zones are gated, access and offloading need to be planned in advance â€” something we handle before dispatch. Share your exact plot, zone and gate details, and we confirm the delivery plan with the quotation.

Which container office suits your Sri City site

Different jobs call for different cabins. As a guide:

  • A gate or single-desk security point â€” a 10 ft cabin
  • A project, admin or supervisor office â€” a 20 ft cabin, the most common choice
  • A larger office with a meeting or record area â€” a 40 ft cabin, which can be partitioned
  • A warehousing or logistics unit â€” a storage container office for SEZ logistics units

Container office sizes

SizeTypical useNotes
10 ftGate office or single supervisor cabinCompact, single door
20 ftProject, admin or supervisor officeMost common for SEZ sites
40 ftLarge office with meeting or record areaCan be partitioned

Internal usable area and layout are confirmed at quotation, since we build to order rather than from stock.

Materials and construction

Every container office we ship to Sri City is built to the same factory standard:

  • Structural frame in MS steel to IS 2062 grade
  • Wall and roof options in PUF sandwich panel or cement/fibre board with a GI sheet roof
  • PUF insulation to hold down heat inside the cabin
  • Ply-and-vinyl flooring, aluminium sliding windows, and steel or laminated doors
  • Electrical points, lighting and a distribution board wired to your layout

Exact panel thickness, wiring load and fittings are set to your spec. Anything non-standard is marked "confirm at quotation" so the price you get is honest.

Customisation options

We fit each cabin to how your unit works. Common additions for Sri City sites include AC provision, internal partitions, an attached toilet, a pantry point, extra windows, a document-storage area, company colour and branding, and an entry ramp or platform. List what you need and it goes into the quote.

Delivery from our Bangalore factory

Sri City is served from our Bangalore factory on South-zone dispatch. The road route runs via Chittoor and the Chennai corridor into the Sri City zones â€” roughly 330â€“380 km depending on your plot and gate. Transit is typically within 4â€“5 days after the unit is built and dispatched. Default delivery is â‚¹3,000 where applicable; the exact freight and any crane offloading are confirmed on the quotation. Returns follow our 7-day, customer-paid return policy.

Planning across the wider region? See container offices we send toward the Chennai belt, the container offices we build at our Bangalore factory, and container offices we supply for Hyderabad units.

Documentation and gate access for SEZ units

Units inside Sri City and their contractors need clean paperwork and planned access. As a registered Private Limited manufacturer, we issue a proper GST invoice (GSTIN 29ABBCS7101B1ZR) and an e-way bill for every dispatch, share our ISO, NSIC and DPIIT certificate numbers for vendor registration, and coordinate the gate-pass and offloading details before the unit leaves our yard. This keeps procurement, access and audit straightforward.

Why buy from SAMAN

SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd has manufactured prefab steel structures since 2009 and has been incorporated since 2019, with 500+ projects delivered. We are certified to ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646) and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), and registered with NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005). Our units carry a 5-year warranty on the structural frame and base and 1â€“2 years on finishing, with a 20â€“25 year engineered service life.

Price factors for a container office in Sri City

We quote to your spec rather than a fixed figure, because the price moves with size (10, 20 or 40 ft), panel and insulation type, AC, electrical and plumbing fit-out, an attached toilet, quantity and the delivery distance to Sri City. Send your requirement and we return a clear, itemised quote â€” no guesswork, no hidden add-ons.

Frequently asked questions

What does a container office cost in Sri City?

There is no single fixed price. The cost depends on size (10, 20 or 40 ft), panel and insulation type, AC, electrical and toilet fit-out, quantity and the delivery distance to your Sri City site. Share your requirement and we send an itemised quote the same way for every buyer.

Do you deliver inside the Sri City SEZ, and how is gate access handled?

Yes. We dispatch from our Bangalore factory via Chittoor and the Chennai corridor to the SEZ, DTZ and FTWZ zones of Sri City (517646). Because the zones are gated, we plan the gate-pass and offloading with you before dispatch.

Which size suits an SEZ project or admin office?

A 20 ft cabin covers most project, admin and supervisor needs, a 10 ft cabin suits a gate or single-desk point, and a 40 ft cabin suits a larger office with a meeting area. Layouts are customised and confirmed at quotation.

Do you provide a GST invoice and certificate numbers for SEZ vendor onboarding?

Yes. We are a GST-registered Private Limited manufacturer and issue a GST invoice and e-way bill for every dispatch, and can share our ISO, NSIC and DPIIT certificate numbers for vendor registration.
